data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: systemd
ui_devex.summary: systemd 是一个现代化的 Linux 系统和服务管理器，它取代了传统的 init 系统，通过并行启动服务和基于依赖关系的管理，显著提升了系统启动速度和服务响应能力。其核心设计采用套接字激活机制，仅在服务真正需要时才分配资源，这种按需启动的理念减少了系统开销。在实际应用中，开发者可以编写 systemd 单元文件来定义自定义服务，利用其强大的日志管理工具 journald 进行故障排查，并通过 systemctl 命令轻松控制守护进程，实现高效的系统运维和自动化部署。
ui_devex.summary_en: systemd is a Linux system and service manager that replaces traditional init systems by providing faster boot times and unified service management. Its technical innovation lies in using socket activation and dependency-based parallel startup, which reduces resource waste and improves system responsiveness. Developers can use systemd to create custom service units, manage daemons efficiently, and implement system-level automation through its comprehensive logging and monitoring tools.

deployment_serving.name: protobuf
deployment_serving.summary: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是谷歌开发的语言中立数据序列化格式，用于高效交换结构化数据。它采用模式优先设计，通过.proto文件定义数据结构，并由编译器自动生成多语言类型安全代码，确保数据一致性和互操作性。生成的二进制格式紧凑高效，优于JSON/XML，适用于构建高性能API、序列化配置及微服务通信，实现跨平台可靠数据传输。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral data serialization format that solves the challenge of efficiently exchanging structured data between different systems and programming languages. Its key innovation is using a schema-first approach where developers define data structures in .proto files, which the protoc compiler then generates into type-safe code for multiple languages. Developers can use protobuf to create efficient APIs, store configuration files, or build microservices by defining message schemas, generating client/server code, and leveraging its compact binary format for fast serialization across network boundaries.
